meta.description: Random 1-3-knob combinations around K59 over every knob the fitted quality model has seen varied in the M9+ era (support_detail(), 29 Sep 23:16Z fit). Values are the ones the campaign ran (or lie between them, 'interp'); a value seen in only one M9+ run is flagged 'weak' by the support check and a pair of knobs never co-observed is flagged 'interaction'. Not included: FF_ATTN_SRC (needs the M14 code: see space-k60-local), FF_RELU2_FN=1 (train.py refuses it next to FF_LEAKY_RELU2=0.35), FF_TIME_TARGET (the upload budget, not a lever), FF_ACC_IN_GRAPH / MTP (era-confounded: no coefficient). Run with --gen random --n-random 400 --workers 8.
meta.ranking: analytic: official_mean = quality mean at the model's step count + offset mean (rng-invariant); official_mc_mean is the Monte Carlo mean; sd, percentiles and P(...) are Monte Carlo
meta.crn: standardised (mean 0, sd 1 per z vector and per coefficient-draw column; offset centred on the model mean and sd)
meta.train_py_rules: K59 upload train.py (M12 code; not shipped, see recipes/K60/train.py)
